system.longDesc:
A flash-bang emits a loud noise and a bright flash of light, intended to blind, deafen, and stun targets. Anyone within 5 yards of the grenade when it goes off must make a TN 15 Constitution (Stamina) test. If it fails, they lose their next round of actions, and are at a –2 penalty on all tests for 1d6 rounds thereafter. If the test succeeds, the target is at only a –1 penalty for 1d3 rounds.

Focus: Grenades. Resources TN 15.
